# rajsuyash.com

Suyash Raj is an AI automation consultant and AI voice-agent expert, based in Paris, and the
founder of Voxdonna AI and AiSewak. This site publishes n8n and AI-agent tutorials alongside his
consulting practice.

## Key pages
- About: https://rajsuyash.com/about.html — who Suyash Raj is, what he builds, companies founded
- Consulting: https://rajsuyash.com/consulting.html — automation architecture and AI-agent readiness advisory
- Case studies: https://rajsuyash.com/case-studies.html — client results (Le Marquier, Usha Martin)
- n8n Automation Guides: https://rajsuyash.com/n8n-automation.html
- AI Agents: https://rajsuyash.com/ai-agents.html
- Blog: https://rajsuyash.com/blog/
- FAQ: https://rajsuyash.com/faq.html
- Contact: grow@rajsuyash.com

## Companies founded
- Voxdonna AI (https://voxdonna.com) — AI voice and WhatsApp agents for enterprises.
- AiSewak (https://aisewak.com) — AI voice agents for Indian government and citizen services.
